_about: Curated OFL families the theme lane may choose from (SPEC 3.2 item 4, D-40). Metadata read from google/fonts METADATA.pb on the main branch on 2026-10-06 (the commit could not be pinned from this environment: googleFontsCommit stays null until tools/fonts-fetch.mjs --pin runs with GitHub API access). source is a committed variable TTF under engine/fonts/sources/ for the families in use today; every other family is fetched (and its OFL header verified) by tools/fonts-fetch.mjs when a site first picks it (Phase 2). A family not in this list, or one whose source is missing when a site uses it, fails the build (font-source-missing, Phase 2); the banned four fail font-banned.
